title: SEC3: FREE callback missing WC_ALGO_TYPE_HASH case
description: The WC_ALGO_TYPE_FREE dispatch in wc_crypto2dev_cb() handles CIPHER, HMAC, and PK but has no case for WC_ALGO_TYPE_HASH. If a wolfSSL hash object with devId set is freed while a streaming hash is in progress (digest never called), the Crypto2DevHashCtx heap allocation and the leased pool op_fd are both leaked. The pool slot is never reclaimed, eventually exhausting the pool.
